items.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
items.summary: Nvidia told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the US tightens efforts to keep AI chips from reaching China.

items.title: Switzerland counts five AI-agent cyberattacks, four successful, as Italy warns too
items.summary: Switzerland counted five AI-agent cyberattacks, four of them successful, while Italy's cyber agency issued a parallel warning.

items.title: Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks
items.summary: Microsoft detailed ARTEX, an AI framework in use since July 2026 that runs largely autonomous cyberattacks with specialised agents, used by Chinese and North Korean state-linked groups and criminals; recommended defences include deception and honeypots.

items.title: Nvidia halts server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia after tighter US export controls
items.summary: Nvidia instructed partners including Dell and Supermicro to halt server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries after new US export controls, leaving thousands of B300 chips and data centre loans in limbo.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: US chip curbs, distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development, sources say
items.summary: Reuters sources say US chip curbs plus a crackdown on model distillation are jointly threatening Chinese AI model development timelines.

items.title: China Telecom releases 285B AI model trained on Ascend chips and MindSpore
items.summary: China Telecom is reported to have released a 285B-parameter model trained on Huawei Ascend chips with the MindSpore framework, signalling further domestic stack independence.

items.title: Singapore reaches out to local firms amid reports of Nvidia chip shipment halt

items.summary: Singapore's government is engaging local firms after reports that Nvidia paused chip shipments to the region under tightened US export controls.

items.title: Anthropic research reveals AI agent sandbox security risks
items.summary: Anthropic research reportedly identifies security weaknesses in sandboxes used to contain AI agents, relevant to enterprise agent deployments.

items.title: ShellBench Benchmark Exposes 40% Failure Rate in Frontier AI Agents, Challenging Enterprise Autonomy Claims + Video

items.title: EU needed 2 requests to get AI incident answers from OpenAI and Anthropic

items.title: Former OpenAI researcher says the Riemann proof matters less than the fact that an AI system can produce it
items.summary: Scott Aaronson argues the significance of recent AI math results lies in the capability demonstrated, and says he is confident labs hold undisclosed cryptography results.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra users now hit limits 40% faster after OpenAI patched a pricing error

items.title: Dutch groups ask court to halt Meta smart glasses sales over privacy concerns

items.title: FCC clears SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites for orbital AI data centers by 2040
items.summary: The FCC authorised SpaceX to deploy up to one million Starmind satellites as orbital AI data centres, with first launches targeted for 2027 and full build-out by 2040; analysts expect costs to exceed terrestrial options.

items.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
items.summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority complained that Meta declined joint pre-deployment testing of its Muse personal agent before its UK rollout, warning of new attack surfaces.

items.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
